artboards.title: Option B - The sun, done properly
Option C - Sun with a charge

annotations.text:
The manifest declares the icon "any maskable", so Android is entitled to crop it to a circle covering the inner 80%. Nothing in the shipped icon respects that circle - masked, it is a plain yellow disc.

The replacement is drawn inside it. The circle specimen on each board is that crop, not a mock-up.

The three directions that were not taken, kept as the record of what was considered.

B is the same sun with a safe zone; C trades the ROI story for a bolt that reads harder at 32px; D is the most specific and the most literal.
